question: At P=16, is retained capacity of (A_0, y_0) graded in consecutive Hamming at each input level, and does frozen (rule-only) sit between drift and jump at fixed Hamming?
why_now: The existing 2×2 is same-vs-different-task × drift-vs-jump. Consecutive s_r=0.9 is Hamming 0 at P=16. Line 2: a similarity scalar is uninterpretable unless stated at a level, and a property varied without being shown to matter has not been probed. Frozen × s_r<1 is the rule-only condition the setup has described and never measured.

design.manipulation: Four exact Hamming levels at P=16, crossed with three input levels. Hamming is requested as s_r in {1.0, 0.75, 0.5, 0.25} so h = (P/2)(1−s_r) is even and does not round. Input is frozen (s_f=1, centres copied, points re-realized), drift (s_f=0.9), jump (s_f=0.1). Same stream_id and same s_r pair dichotomies and A_0 across the three input levels; later A_t differ by design.
